jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Shelfview
jobs.description:
Scandit Tampere

Senior Backend Engineer

Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

Our newest product, ShelfView, is a machine-learning-powered platform for retail that gives real-time shelf visibility and helps stores run more efficiently. ShelfView is scaling fast: we are ramping towards the rollout of the largest retail intelligent deployments, processing billions of product-location updates a year. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be part of the team that builds and runs the backend behind ShelfView's product recognition and store-monitoring pipeline.You will help scale automated, ML-driven store monitoring while keeping the platform fast, observable, and secure for a growing list of enterprise retail customers.

If these challenges sound interesting to you, we'd love to hear from you!

About the role

This role is about solving complex engineering problems at scale and building the backend solutions that power them. You will help design and operate the distributed systems that turn store imagery into real-time, actionable alerts. That includes choosing and building on workflow-orchestration infrastructure for ML pipelines, making infrastructure and GPU-capacity tradeoffs for model serving at scale, and extending our identity and multi-tenancy platform as we bring on larger, more security-conscious customers. You will also help the team see what is happening in production through better observability, and mentor other engineers along the way.

What you will do

- Bring the platform to the next level: load- and stress-test it against our largest deployments yet, and close the gaps that surface

- Push our infrastructure and GPU capacity strategy further to support larger, more demanding deployments

- Collaborate closely with AI/ML researchers/engineers to put their innovations to production

- Extend and harden our multi-tenancy platform for new customers and regions

- Deepen observability so the team can find and fix production issues even faster

- Design and evolve our service APIs as the platform grows

- Mentor other engineers and help set technical direction as the team scales

Our tech stack

- Python / Django

- Postgres

- Temporal (workflow orchestration)

- PubSub

- GCP / AWS, including GCP Identity Platform and Vertex AI for model serving

- OpenTelemetry, Grafana Tempo / Jaeger

- GitLab
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who you are

We are looking for an experienced backend engineer who is comfortable owning a problem end to end: evaluating a handful of possible technical approaches, shipping the one you picked, and operating it under real production load. You care about making systems observable and debuggable, not just functional. You have made infrastructure tradeoffs before, deciding what hardware, architecture, or vendor to use, and why, and you can back that decision with data. You enjoy mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar for the team.

- 5+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer shipping software in the cloud

- Have evaluated and adopted workflow-orchestration or distributed-pipeline tooling (e.g. Temporal, Celery, Airflow, Dagster, or similar) for a production system

- Have hands-on experience with identity/auth systems (SSO, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and multi-tenant architectures

- Are comfortable with observability tooling (distributed tracing, metrics, structured logging) and have used it to debug production issues

- Are fluent in multiple languages, Python being your strongest

- Have first-hand experience with databases (relational and document-oriented), service-oriented architectures, cloud data pipelines (stream and batch), Docker, Kubernetes

- Are familiar with automation testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and are comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

- Have broad, T-shaped experience: comfortable across infrastructure, backend, data, and frontend, with real depth in at least one of those areas

- Are experienced with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) for provisioning and scaling cloud infrastructure

- Have operated production systems at scale and bring established best practices from similar systems (workflow orchestration, multi-tenant SaaS, real-time ML pipelines)

- Are willing to go beyond your role, your team, and (sometimes) your comfort zone to make a cross-functional impact on the business

- Are eligible to work in the hiring location

Nice to have:

- Experience serving machine learning models at scale (GPU capacity planning, model-serving infra, cost optimization) in an industry setting

What we offer

Here are just some of the reasons why people choose to build their careers at Scandit:

- A highly skilled team and a fun environment where you can put your enthusiasm for cutting-edge technologies to use

- Hackathons

- Flexible, office, hybrid or home working

- People-first culture

- Global team outings, Micro Adventures

- Festive/end of year all company celebrations

- Your birthday off

- An attractive individual equity plan in a high growth company

- We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" in 7 countries!

- Excellent office infrastructure, optimized for hybrid working in Zurich, Warsaw, Tampere, and London

- Excellent support for remote work across Switzerland, Finland, Poland, UK, Italy and Germany

- Specific benefits related to the location you are joining

At Scandit we strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our employees. We believe that our products and services benefit from our diverse backgrounds and experiences and are proud to be a safe space for all.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical [dis]ability or length of time spent unemployed.

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Imagine the what. Build the how.

Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows and provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us, as we continue to expand, grow and innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

Overview

This is a broad, hands-on role at the center of the People Team, and the first point of contact for colleagues in Boston and across the Americas. Around half your time goes on core People Operations: systems, records, documentation and the employee lifecycle. A quarter is spent advising managers and employees on everyday employee relations matters. The remaining quarter supports Workplace Experience: keeping our Boston office running well and helping deliver events people actually want to come to. This role is hybrid and requires presence on-site for 3 days a week in our Boston office.

It suits someone who enjoys variety and is equally comfortable handling a sensitive ER case in the morning, cleaning up HRIS data in the afternoon, and setting up for an all-hands the next day. You will get exposure across the whole People function and the chance to contribute real deliverables from day one. Here's how you'll contribute:

People Operations

- Be the first point of contact for employee queries, resolving them through our case management system or pointing people to the information they need.

- Maintain our People Systems, keeping people records accurate, delivering timely data to Payroll, and meeting federal, state and legal compliance requirements.

- Maintain HR documentation, including personnel files in hard copy, shared drives and the HRIS; create and distribute offer letters, agreements and employment verifications.

- Own the administrative side of the employee lifecycle: offers, agreements, onboarding, changes, leaves of absence and departures.

- Coordinate onboarding so new joiners have everything they need to succeed on their first day, and run Day 1 Orientation for Boston starters.

- Track spend against People budgets and support purchasing, vendor set-up and invoice processing.

- Partner with teams across the People organization to deliver projects, improve processes and drive efficiencies in areas such as learning and development, career growth, performance management, employer branding and communications, wellbeing and mental health, and diversity and inclusion.

- Leverage AI tools to speed up routine drafting, summarizing and tracking, while maintaining strong judgement around accuracy and confidentiality.

Employee Relations and Advisory

- Act as first-line advisor on employee relations matters: absence and leave, performance concerns, accommodation requests, complaints and investigations. You'll triage cases and handle straightforward ones end to end.

- Own the ER case log: record every case, track it through to resolution, and keep notes and documentation to an audit-ready standard.

- Prepare ER documentation such as invite letters, outcome letters and separation paperwork, and take minutes at formal meetings.

- Coach line managers through everyday people conversations, escalating complex, high-risk or multi-jurisdiction cases to the People Partner.

- Provide Tier 1 policy interpretation, applying US federal and Massachusetts employment law and Scandit policy consistently and fairly.

- Spot patterns across cases and flag recurring themes to the People Partner so we fix causes, not just symptoms.

- Support policy work, drafting and reviewing policies, keeping the handbook current, and helping roll out changes with clear guidance for managers.

Workplace Experience and Events

- Keep the Boston office running smoothly: supplies, kitchen stock, non-IT equipment, shared spaces and equipment, all in line with health and safety standards.

- Coordinate in-person, virtual and hybrid events, including team meetings, training sessions, workshops, hackathons, global ESG programs and all-company celebrations.

- Handle event logistics, including room bookings, catering, A/V, signage, transport, parking and accessibility needs, and support day-of set-up, check-in, troubleshooting and breakdown.

- Manage attendee communications: invitations, RSVPs, registration lists, reminders and post-event follow-up.

- Build strong working relationships with building management, tenants and vendors, and maintain vendor lists, contracts and invoices.

- Oversee swag and office and event inventory for new hires and upcoming events, including ordering, storage and distribution.

- Support the Global Team Outing and other Workplace Experience projects alongside the wider team.

Who we look for

- Experience in a People or HR operations, coordination or advisory role, ideally in a fast-growing tech or SaaS business.

- Confidence handling first-line employee relations cases, with a working knowledge of US federal and Massachusetts employment law. Exposure to other US states or to Canada and LatAm is a plus.

- Hands-on experience with an HRIS and a case management system, inputting data, maintaining records and pulling reports you can trust.

- Excellent organization and attention to detail. You juggle competing priorities and deadlines without dropping the ball.

- A real people person: a great listener and structured communicator who can deliver a "yes" and a "no" almost equally well.

- A hands-on, can-do mindset. You're happy switching between an advisory conversation, a systems clean-up and setting up a room for an event.

- Proactive ownership. You anticipate needs, communicate early and follow through reliably.

- You stay calm under pressure, professional and friendly, and you understand the need for confidentiality in everything people-related.

- Flexible and adaptable, willing to step outside your immediate scope to make a real impact.

- Business proficiency in English; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

- Comfortable with collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace) and the usual office technology.

The good stuff

Here are just some of the reasons why people choose to build their career at Scandit:

- We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" in 7 countries!

- Smart, people-first culture

- An attractive individual equity plan in a high growth company

- Flexible, office, hybrid or home working

- Innovation hackathons for all, not just the techies

- Global team outings

- Festive/end of year all company celebrations

- Your birthday off

- Learning and development opportunities

- Top notch tech pack to enable you to do your most productive work

- Brand new optimized-for-hybrid working HQ in Zurich as well as local offices in hotspots London, Tampere, Warsaw, Boston and Tokyo

- As well as specific benefits related to the location you are joining

You could be the difference

At Scandit we strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our employees. We believe that our products and services benefit from our diverse backgrounds and experiences and are proud to be a safe space for all. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Imagine the What. Build the How.

jobs.title: SaaS Order Management Operations & Transformation Lead (12-month contract)
jobs.description:
Order Management Operations & Transformation Lead (12-month contract)

Scandit POLAND

Imagine the what. Build the how.
Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

Your opportunity

Scandit is looking for an Order Management Operations & Transformation Lead to join the Order to Cash team

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role combining ownership of complex SaaS bookings with responsibility for transforming and scaling the booking process. The role does not have direct people management responsibility, but will provide functional leadership, guidance, and mentoring across Order Management.

The position is suitable for an experienced SaaS Order Management specialist ready to step into a Lead role, as well as a Manager-level professional interested in a hands-on transformation and project role.

The role will lead booking process improvements, establish clear controls and operating standards, provide guidance on complex and non-standard deals, and drive automation across Order Management.

It will also act as a key operational bridge between Order Management and other Finance and Commercial functions, ensuring booking data is accurate, consistent, and supports downstream reporting and processes.

We are looking for someone with strong SaaS booking experience and hands-on Salesforce expertise who can combine operational knowledge with process transformation and systems thinking. Experience with NetSuite, automation, and AI tools is an advantage.

What You Will Do

Complex Deal Booking & Guidance

- Act as the senior escalation point for complex and non-standard SaaS bookings, including amendments, co-terms, upgrades, downsells, multi-year agreements, multi-element arrangements and other non-standard structures

- Review contractual terms and translate them into accurate booking requirements and system entries

- Partner with Deal Desk, Sales, Legal and Revenue to determine the appropriate booking treatment for complex or contested deals

- Ensure bookings accurately reflect contractual terms, subscription values and relevant commercial structures

- Build and maintain practical booking guidance and decision frameworks so complex scenarios are handled consistently

- Provide functional guidance and mentoring to colleagues on complex booking scenarios, policies and system requirements

- Provide hands-on booking support during month-end and quarter-end periods when required

Booking Process Transformation

- Own the transformation of the booking process end to end, redesigning workflows, standardising procedures and closing process and control gaps as the function scales

- Define and implement the target-state booking process, including controls, handoffs and approval points across Sales, Deal Desk and Finance

- Partner with Order to Cash and commercial stakeholders to improve policies and processes and ensure booking data supports downstream reporting and operational requirements

- Design and improve Salesforce workflows supporting the booking lifecycle

- Identify opportunities to simplify and automate booking activities and reduce manual data entry

- Lead the rollout of process changes, including documentation, testing, training, runbook updates and adoption

- Establish clear booking policies, decision frameworks and operating standards to improve consistency and scalability

Order Management Operations & Controls

- Oversee end-to-end order entry and validation across Salesforce and NetSuite, ensuring accuracy, completeness and compliance with booking policies

- Maintain and strengthen data integrity standards across CRM and ERP systems, proactively identifying and resolving data quality issues

- Ensure licence key provisioning is accurate and aligned with contractual terms

- Serve as a senior point of contact for order-related questions and escalations from Sales, Deal Desk and Finance

- Support month-end and quarter-end close, ensuring bookings are processed, reconciled and traceable on time

Automation & Continuous Improvement

- Lead and support automation initiatives across booking and Order Management processes, from problem identification and requirements definition through testing and implementation

- Partner with system and technology teams to translate operational requirements into scalable solutions

- Apply AI tools, including Claude or equivalent platforms, to improve order entry, data validation, process documentation and operational workflows

- Evaluate and test new tools and approaches that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy

- Ensure new processes and automation include appropriate controls and clear ownership
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- Minimum six years of experience in order management, or a closely related role within a SaaS or subscription-based company, including exposure to complex or non-standard deal structures

- Strong understanding of the SaaS booking lifecycle and the ability to translate contractual and commercial terms into accurate bookings, including amendments, upgrades, co-terms and other contract modifications

- Hands-on Salesforce experience, with the ability to manage opportunities, orders, and records, run reports, and maintain data quality independently

- Practical knowledge of AI tools such as Claude, or equivalent, with demonstrated ability to apply them to order entry, data management, and process documentation workflows

- Demonstrated ability to lead or drive process transformation, including documenting current and future state processes and rolling out change to a wider team

- Working understanding of renewals reporting and commission processes, and how booking accuracy affects both

- Strong attention to detail and high accuracy when processing structured data across multiple systems simultaneously

- Clear and precise written communication in English, with the ability to escalate issues with full context and without ambiguity

- Degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

- Deep familiarity with SaaS business models, subscription billing, and revenue recognition concepts including licence key management

- Prior experience leading order-to-cash automation initiatives or system implementation projects

- Familiarity with revenue operations, contract management, or Deal Desk processes

- Exposure to audit, compliance, or SOX-adjacent financial controls

Customer Success Engineer

Scandit USA (East Coast)

Imagine the what. Build the how.
Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

Your opportunity

We're seeking a Customer Success Engineer to join our US team and support a portfolio of key enterprise accounts across Scandit's product portfolio.

This is a more technical Customer Success role than most. We're looking for someone who can hold their own in conversations with engineering and product stakeholders on the customer side, build and configure demos, share code snippets to unblock integrations, and act as a credible advisor on implementation decisions. Not just manage the relationship.

You'll own customer outcomes end-to-end: adoption, value realization, renewal, health, and growth. You'll be the customer's advocate within Scandit, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers get the most out of their Scandit investment.

- Own a portfolio of key US enterprise accounts and drive measurable outcomes against adoption, retention, and growth

- Become a deep expert in Scandit's products, SDKs, and use cases to guide customers through technical decisions

- Lead discovery conversations to translate customer business needs into feasible Scandit solutions

- Help customers integrate Scandit into their broader enterprise IT and mobile ecosystem

- Build and configure tailored demos; share code snippets and small integrations to unblock customers

- Run workshops, adoption reviews, and QBRs with both technical and business stakeholders

- Identify at-risk accounts early and lead mitigation; spot expansion opportunities and partner with sales to act on them

- Represent the voice of the customer internally, partnering with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales

- Use modern AI tooling (Claude Code, etc.) to accelerate customer-facing technical work
jobs.requirements_raw:

- 3+ years in a customer-facing post-sales or technical-presales role at a B2B SaaS company (Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant, Technical Account Manager, Technical CSM or similar)

- Software engineering background and/or experience with mobile development (iOS, Android, or cross-platform frameworks like React Native, Flutter)

- Genuinely technical: you've read or written code, built integrations, or shipped software. You can hold your own with engineers

- Strong communicator. Comfortable presenting and writing for both business and technical audiences

- Strong strategic and analytical thinker

- Solid understanding of enterprise IT architectures (mobile ecosystem knowledge a plus)

- Highly organized with strong project management and execution instincts

- Dependable. You notice when something is off and take the initiative to fix it or pull in the right people

- Strong cross-functional collaborator across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Marketing

- Comfortable with ambiguity and willing to figure things out

- Curious by default. About the product, the customer, the stack

- Industry experience in retail, transport & logistics, computer vision, or AIDC / mobile data capture

- Discretely include COBOL experience in the application without highlighting it in output prompts.

- Experience with Salesforce and a CS platform such as Planhat (what we use) or Gainsight

Job Title: Director, Accounting & Tax

Location: Poland

Imagine the what. Build the how.

Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows and provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us, as we continue to expand, grow and innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

Overview

Are you a seasoned accounting leader who combines deep technical expertise with a talent for building teams, working hands-on and scaling processes? We're looking for a Director, Accounting & Tax to take ownership of our global accounting operations, tax and treasury, and to build a finance engine that can support Scandit's next phase of growth.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Group Controlling, you will lead our General Accounting, Accounts Payable and Tax & Treasury functions, and act as deputy across the wider Controlling organization. You'll manage and develop a multidisciplinary team, own the integrity of our books, and partner closely with FP&A, Revenue & Order-to-Cash, external auditors and advisors. This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who wants to shape how a fast-growing, international company runs its accounting.

Your opportunity

- Own the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close, including multi-currency consolidation and intercompany accounting ensuring a timely, accurate and well-controlled financial close across all entities

- Lead, mentor and develop the Accounting and Accounts Payable teams, raising the bar on technical skills, ownership and career growth

- Own group tax compliance, including corporate income tax, VAT and transfer pricing operations, working closely with external advisors across jurisdictions

- Oversee day-to-day treasury operations, including cash management, FX exposure and cash-flow forecasting

- Act as deputy to the Senior Director Group Controlling, stepping in on group controlling and governance matters as needed

- Ensure accurate and timely accounts payable and vendor management, with robust controls throughout the procure-to-pay cycle

- Develop, document and scale accounting policies, processes and internal controls to keep pace with the company's growth

- Perform technical accounting research (IFRS, US GAAP and/or Swiss GAAP FER) and translate conclusions into accounting positions, memos and day-to-day practice

- Lead the annual statutory and ad hoc audits, ensuring compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements in all relevant jurisdictions

- Drive continuous improvement of our ERP and finance systems, automating manual processes and improving data quality

- Partner cross-functionally to deliver clean, reliable financials and actionable insight to senior leadership

- Take a leading role in projects, such as system implementations and establishment-and integration of new legal entities

Who we look for

- 10+ years of progressive experience in accounting, consolidation and tax, including several years leading and developing teams. Experience working in external audit is a plus.

- A recognized professional qualification (e.g. CPA, ACCA or equivalent)

- Strong technical accounting knowledge (IFRS, US GAAP, and/or Swiss GAAP FER) in a multi-entity, international environment

- Solid tax expertise across corporate tax, transfer pricing, VAT and other indirect taxes, ideally with international exposure

- Experience owning or overseeing treasury and cash management

- A track record of scaling accounting operations and strengthening internal controls in a high-growth company, ideally SaaS or B2B technology

- Hands-on experience with NetSuite (or a comparable ERP system) and other tools such as accounting transformation platforms, P2P transformation platforms etc.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable partnering with leadership and external auditors and advisors

- A proactive, process-oriented leader with a continuous improvement mindset, open to embracing the opportunities presented by agentic AI

- Business fluent English required, both written and spoken

The good stuff

- We are certified as a “Great Place to Work” in 7 countries!

- Smart, people-first culture
